styleException.description: indicator's computed fill width (style: indicator_style at progress.rs:46)
styleException.reason: The indicator's width is a runtime percentage computed from the current value; Tailwind has no static utility for an arbitrary runtime percentage.

inspirationNote: Track and indicator classes (relative h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-primary/20; h-full w-full flex-1 bg-primary transition-all) match shadcn's current source verbatim. dioxus-components uses CSS modules (external style.css files), not Tailwind, so no Tailwind class-level comparison is possible there.
